WITH CASH AS( SELECT DISTINCT cur.BOK_DETAIL_ID, todo.SEQ_NO, todo.BOOKSET_DATE, todo.BOOK_DATE, todo.HAPPEN_DATE, todo.TASK_ID FROM BOK_BATCH_TASK_TODO todo INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT cur ON cur.BOOKSET_ID = todo.BOOKSET_ID AND cur.BOOKSET_DATE = todo.BOOKSET_DATE INNER JOIN BOK_SUBJECT_NATURE_GROUP grp ON grp.GROUP_ID = 'XJL_KMCX' AND cur.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE = grp.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE
) SELECT TRADE_ID ,HAPPEN_DATE ,BOOK_DATE ,BOOKSET_DATE ,BOOKSET_ID ,BOK_DETAIL_ID FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT.TRADE_ID ORDER BY BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT.BOOK_ORDER desc )as rn ,BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT.TRADE_ID ,BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT.HAPPEN_DATE ,BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT.BOOK_DATE ,BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT.BOOKSET_DATE ,BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT.BOOK_ORDER ,BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT.BOOKSET_ID ,BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT.BOK_DETAIL_ID FROM BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT INNER JOIN CASH ON BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT.BOK_DETAIL_ID = CASH.BOK_DETAIL_ID AND CASH.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo} AND CASH.BOOKSET_DATE = #{BOOKSET_DATE} AND CASH.BOOK_DATE = #{BOOK_DATE} AND CASH.HAPPEN_DATE = #{HAPPEN_DATE} AND CASH.TASK_ID = #{taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE 1 = 1 AND BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT.HAPPEN_DATE = #{HAPPEN_DATE,jdbcType=DATE} AND BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT.BOOK_DATE <= #{BOOK_DATE,jdbcType=DATE} ) TMP WHERE rn = 1 AND (BOOKSET_DATE != #{BOOKSET_DATE,jdbcType=DATE} OR BOOK_DATE != #{BOOK_DATE,jdbcType=DATE}) ORDER BY BOOK_ORDER
